system.description:
The kill that feeds the next kill. The more you destroy, the stronger you become.

  • Dark Gift (1st): When you reduce a creature to 0 HP or below, your next damaging cantrip or spell gains +1 damage die. Stacks up to 3 times per encounter.
  • Patron's Mark (6th): Once per day, designate one creature as prey — for the next hour you know their exact location and whether they are fleeing, hiding, or preparing to fight.
  • Patron Feature (12th): Once per day, declare a Hunt on one creature within 120ft — you always know its location, your spells deal +2d6 against it, and if it drops you to 0 HP or below first, make a Will save against your Class Save DC to stay at 1 HP instead.

Allegiance: Chaotic Evil, the patron's alignment. Lore: Yeenoghu in the World of Arneyan wiki.
